title: Compare the specified native and condensed derived exchange arrows
statement: Fix a field $k$ of positive prime characteristic and a prime $l\ne\operatorname{char}(k)$. Let $\Lambda$ be a bundled commutative condensed monoid object, with a specified equality $h_\Lambda:\Lambda=\operatorname{Mon.mk}(\overline{\mathbb Q}_l)$ fixing the standard locally finite condensed ring structure. Consider any Cartesian square $v:X'\to X$, $p':X'\to Y'$, $p:X\to Y$, $g:Y'\to Y$ of separated quasi-compact schemes locally of finite type over $k$, with all maps over $k$. Use the native module categories [def-sf-native-weil-derived-framework]. For each scheme $T$, let $E_T$ be scalar forgetting followed by restriction along the normalized coefficient-realization family used in the native sectionwise module presentation [def-sf-native-sectionwise-module-presentation], transported along $h_\Lambda$ to modules over $\Lambda_T$. Let $M$ be any native derived complex on $X$, let $K$ be a bounded-constructible condensed complex on $X$, and fix an isomorphism $e:D(E_X)M\simeq K$. Then $D(E_{Y'})$ applied to the specified native exchange at $M$ [def-sf-native-derived-exchange-map] is isomorphic as an arrow to the underlying arrow of the specified conditional bounded-constructible condensed exchange at $K$, with algebraic-closure $l$-adic coefficients and the preservation proof rationalCoefficientPushforwardPreservation [det-thm-sfb-proper-base-change-rational]. No properness hypothesis is assumed, and neither arrow is asserted to be invertible.

proof.text: Use the normalized ordinary pullback cube. Localize it with mapDerivedCategory_exactCube. The theorem derived_exact_forget_mate identifies the mates of the localized pull comparisons with derivedPushComparison. Apply exchangeMate_cube to produce the isomorphism from the encoded native exchange to the exact condensed exchange. Naturality in the input and transport along hΛ give this comparison at the specified K.obj for the bundled coefficient Λ.

proof.text: Expand the canonical exact-to-total-left-derived comparisons and their compositors. Pasting the two composition identities across the square gives the total-to-exact cube. The derived adjunction is the exact adjunction transported along this left comparison; the corresponding right mate is the identity by the triangle identity. The mate cube therefore compares the total ambient and exact condensed exchanges.

proof.text: The bounded-constructible inclusion takes the restricted compositor to the ambient compositor because its fully faithful preimage has that image. Equality transport and inversion give the same statement for the pullback square. Ell-adic bounded constructibility is triangulated on these noetherian schemes. Apply the established full-subcategory exchange normalization. After rewriting the component, normalize the arrow endpoints using the object equations for restricted pullback and pushforward; the underlying restricted arrow is then the ambient total-derived arrow. Compose the native-to-exact comparison with the inverse of the total-to-exact comparison.

theorem nativeDerivedExchange_condensed_comparison
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (k : Type u) [Field k]
    [Fact (ringChar k).Prime] [Fact (ringChar k ≠ l)]
    (Λ : Mon (Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) Ab.{u + 1}))
    [IsCommMonObj Λ.X] (hΛ : Λ = Mon.mk (Profinite.padicAlgClRingObj l))
    {X' X Y' Y : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))}
    [LocallyOfFiniteType X'.hom]
    [QuasiCompact X'.hom]
    [IsSeparated X'.hom]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType X.hom]
    [QuasiCompact X.hom]
    [IsSeparated X.hom]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType Y'.hom]
    [QuasiCompact Y'.hom]
    [IsSeparated Y'.hom]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType Y.hom]
    [QuasiCompact Y.hom]
    [IsSeparated Y.hom]
    {v : X' ⟶ X} {p' : X' ⟶ Y'} {p : X ⟶ Y} {g : Y' ⟶ Y}
    (sq : IsPullback v p' p g) (M : DerivedCategory (AdicSheaf l X.left))
    (K : BoundedConstructible (condensedRingObj Λ.X X.left))
    (e : (nativeExchangeEncodingAt l Λ hΛ X.left).mapDerivedCategory.obj M ≅ K.obj) :
    Nonempty (Arrow.mk ((nativeExchangeEncodingAt l Λ hΛ Y'.left).mapDerivedCategory.map
        ((adicDerivedBaseChange l
          ((Over.forget (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))).map_commSq sq.toCommSq)).app M)) ≅
      nativeUnderlyingExchangeArrow (boundedConstructible (condensedRingObj Λ.X Y'.left))
        ((CondensedRing.boundedConstructibleBaseChangeOfPreserves Λ.X l
          (CondensedRing.rationalCoefficientPushforwardPreservation l Λ (Or.inr hΛ))
          sq.toCommSq).app K))
